settings.title: 🧬 The Problem: DHT
settings.text: DHT is a hormone that binds to receptors in your scalp - In excess it shrinks follicles, causing hair to thin and shed.

settings.title: 🌿 The Solution: Natural Blockers
settings.text: Our formula combines vitamins, herbs, botanical extracts, and other natural ingredients to reduce DHT levels safely.

settings.title: 💪 The Impact: Stronger Growth
settings.text: By lowering DHT, your follicles stay open and nourished, supporting regrowth, thickness, and healthier hair long term.
